"px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cyan-600 text-white font-bold text-[10px] shadow transition-all flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer" : "px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-purple-950/80 border border-purple-500/30 text-purple-300 text-[10px] hover:text-white transition-all flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"; } if (dot) { dot.className = (i === index) ?
